import unittest
from dictate.platform.generic import PynputHotkey
class Listener: def __init__(self, **kwargs: object) -> None: self.callbacks = kwargs self.started = False self.stopped = False def start(self) -> None: self.started = True def stop(self) -> None: self.stopped = True
class Key: name = "alt_r"
class GenericAltKey: name = "alt"
class HotkeyTests(unittest.TestCase): def test_matching_key_emits_one_press_and_release(self) -> None: events: list[str] = [] listeners: list[Listener] = [] def factory(**kwargs: object) -> Listener: listener = Listener(**kwargs) listeners.append(listener) return listener monitor = PynputHotkey("right_alt", lambda: events.append("press"), lambda: events.append("release"), factory) monitor.start() listener = listeners[0] listener.callbacks["on_press"](Key()) listener.callbacks["on_press"](Key()) listener.callbacks["on_release"](Key()) self.assertEqual(["press", "release"], events) monitor.stop() self.assertTrue(listener.stopped)
def test_right_option_accepts_macos_generic_alt_release(self) -> None: events: list[str] = [] listeners: list[Listener] = []
def factory(**kwargs: object) -> Listener: listener = Listener(**kwargs) listeners.append(listener) return listener
monitor = PynputHotkey("right_alt", lambda: events.append("press"), lambda: events.append("release"), factory) monitor.start() listener = listeners[0] listener.callbacks["on_press"](Key()) listener.callbacks["on_release"](GenericAltKey()) self.assertEqual(["press", "release"], events)

from __future__ import annotations
import unittest from types import ModuleType from unittest.mock import patch
from dictate.platform.base import TargetSnapshot from dictate.platform.linux import LinuxAdapter from dictate.platform.macos import MacOSAdapter, _PyObjCAccessibility from dictate.platform.windows import WindowsAdapter
class Hotkey: def __init__(self) -> None: self.started = False self.stopped = False
def start(self) -> None: self.started = True def stop(self) -> None: self.stopped = True
class Accessibility: def __init__(self) -> None: self.allowed = True self.application, self.window, self.element = object(), object(), object() self.editable_target = True self.replacements: list[tuple[object, str]] = [] self.replacement_succeeds = True
def trusted(self) -> bool: return self.allowed def focused_target(self) -> tuple[object, object, object] | None: return (self.application, self.window, self.element) def application_id(self, application: object) -> str | None: return "app" if application is self.application else None def window_id(self, window: object) -> str | None: return "window" if window is self.window else None def editable(self, element: object) -> bool: return self.editable_target and element is self.element def same(self, first: object, second: object) -> bool: return first is second def replace_selected_text(self, element: object, text: str) -> bool: self.replacements.append((element, text)) return self.replacement_succeeds
class PlatformAdapterTests(unittest.TestCase): def test_platform_runtime_acquisition_uses_one_documented_route(self) -> None: for adapter_type in (MacOSAdapter, WindowsAdapter, LinuxAdapter): with self.subTest(adapter=adapter_type.__name__): commands: list[tuple[str, ...]] = [] result = adapter_type(lambda *_args: Hotkey()).acquire_external_runtime( "whisper-runtime", lambda command: commands.append(tuple(command)) or True ) self.assertTrue(result.acquired) self.assertEqual(1, len(commands)) self.assertFalse(adapter_type(lambda *_args: Hotkey()).acquire_external_runtime("unknown", lambda _command: True).acquired)
def test_non_macos_adapters_fail_closed_for_target_safety(self) -> None: for adapter_type in (WindowsAdapter, LinuxAdapter): with self.subTest(adapter=adapter_type.__name__): hotkeys: list[Hotkey] = []
def factory(*args: object) -> Hotkey: hotkey = Hotkey() hotkeys.append(hotkey) return hotkey
adapter = adapter_type(factory) self.assertTrue(adapter.microphone_permission().available) self.assertTrue(adapter.trigger_permission().available) self.assertFalse(adapter.placement_permission().available) self.assertFalse(adapter.context_permission().available) self.assertIsNone(adapter.snapshot_target()) self.assertFalse(adapter.target_matches(object())) self.assertFalse(adapter.insert_text(object(), "must-not-be-inserted")) adapter.start_hotkey("right_alt", lambda: None, lambda: None) adapter.stop_hotkey() self.assertTrue(hotkeys[0].started) self.assertTrue(hotkeys[0].stopped)
def test_macos_microphone_authorization_is_explicit_and_content_free(self) -> None: calls: list[object] = [] adapter = MacOSAdapter( lambda *_args: Hotkey(), microphone_authorized=lambda: calls.append(object()) or True, accessibility_factory=Accessibility, ) self.assertTrue(adapter.microphone_permission().available) self.assertEqual(1, len(calls))
denied = MacOSAdapter(lambda *_args: Hotkey(), microphone_authorized=lambda: False, accessibility_factory=Accessibility) capability = denied.microphone_permission() self.assertFalse(capability.available) self.assertIn("Microphone", capability.remediation or "")
def test_macos_accessibility_snapshot_revalidates_and_releases_target(self) -> None: accessibility = Accessibility() adapter = MacOSAdapter(lambda *_args: Hotkey(), microphone_authorized=lambda: True, accessibility_factory=lambda: accessibility) self.assertTrue(adapter.placement_permission().available) target = adapter.snapshot_target() self.assertIsInstance(target, TargetSnapshot) assert target is not None self.assertTrue(adapter.target_matches(target)) self.assertTrue(adapter.insert_text(target, "verified text")) self.assertEqual([(accessibility.element, "verified text")], accessibility.replacements) adapter.release_target(target) self.assertFalse(adapter.target_matches(target)) self.assertFalse(adapter.insert_text(target, "must-not-be-inserted"))
def test_macos_focus_change_or_missing_accessibility_never_inserts(self) -> None: accessibility = Accessibility() adapter = MacOSAdapter(lambda *_args: Hotkey(), microphone_authorized=lambda: True, accessibility_factory=lambda: accessibility) target = adapter.snapshot_target() assert target is not None accessibility.element = object() self.assertFalse(adapter.target_matches(target)) self.assertFalse(adapter.insert_text(target, "must-not-be-inserted")) self.assertEqual([], accessibility.replacements)
unavailable = MacOSAdapter(lambda *_args: Hotkey(), microphone_authorized=lambda: True, accessibility_factory=lambda: (_ for _ in ()).throw(ImportError())) self.assertFalse(unavailable.placement_permission().available) self.assertIsNone(unavailable.snapshot_target())
def test_macos_falls_back_to_keyboard_only_for_the_verified_target(self) -> None: accessibility = Accessibility() accessibility.replacement_succeeds = False written: list[str] = [] adapter = MacOSAdapter( lambda *_args: Hotkey(), microphone_authorized=lambda: True, accessibility_factory=lambda: accessibility, text_writer=written.append, ) target = adapter.snapshot_target() assert target is not None
self.assertTrue(adapter.insert_text(target, "terminal or browser text")) self.assertEqual(["terminal or browser text"], written)
accessibility.element = object() self.assertFalse(adapter.insert_text(target, "must-not-be-inserted")) self.assertEqual(["terminal or browser text"], written)
def test_pyobjc_bridge_uses_stable_attribute_keys_when_constants_are_not_exported(self) -> None: module = ModuleType("ApplicationServices") module.AXIsProcessTrusted = lambda: True module.AXUIElementCreateSystemWide = lambda: object() pid_result: list[tuple[int, int]] = [(0, 42)] module.AXUIElementGetPid = lambda _element, _pid: pid_result[0] queried: list[str] = [] editable_value: list[object | None] = [True] window_number: list[object | None] = [7] role: list[object] = [7]
def copy(_element: object, attribute: str, out_value: object) -> tuple[int, object]: self.assertIsNone(out_value) queried.append(attribute) if attribute == "AXEditable": return (0, editable_value[0]) if attribute == "AXWindowNumber": return (0, window_number[0]) if attribute == "AXRole": return (0, role[0]) return (0, 7)
module.AXUIElementCopyAttributeValue = copy module.AXUIElementSetAttributeValue = lambda _element, _attribute, _value: 0 module.kAXFocusedApplicationAttribute = "AXFocusedApplication" module.kAXFocusedUIElementAttribute = "AXFocusedUIElement" module.kAXFocusedWindowAttribute = "AXFocusedWindow" module.kAXRoleAttribute = "AXRole" module.kAXSelectedTextAttribute = "AXSelectedText" module.kAXTextAreaRole = 7 module.kAXTextFieldRole = 8 with patch.dict("sys.modules", {"ApplicationServices": module}): bridge = _PyObjCAccessibility() self.assertEqual("window:7", bridge.window_id(object())) window_number[0] = None self.assertEqual("window-pid:42", bridge.window_id(object())) pid_result[0] = (1, 42) self.assertIsNone(bridge.window_id(object())) pid_result[0] = (0, 42) self.assertTrue(bridge.editable(object())) role[0] = "AXComboBox" self.assertTrue(bridge.editable(object())) role[0] = "AXGroup" self.assertTrue(bridge.editable(object())) editable_value[0] = None self.assertFalse(bridge.editable(object())) role[0] = 7 self.assertTrue(bridge.editable(object())) editable_value[0] = False self.assertFalse(bridge.editable(object())) self.assertIn("AXWindowNumber", queried) self.assertIn("AXEditable", queried)
if __name__ == "__main__": unittest.main()
